pkgmetadata.longdescription: RealtimeSTT is a robust, low-latency speech-to-text library featuring voice activity detection (WebRTC VAD and Silero VAD), wake word activation (Porcupine and OpenWakeWord), and real-time transcription via multiple backends including faster-whisper, whisper.cpp, and OpenAI Whisper.

use.flag: Enable the faster-whisper CTranslate2 transcription backend
